title: plugin-grid: a list column's inline locale-map `label` (spec `I18nLabel`) is silently dropped — `resolveColumnLabel` keeps only a plain string, so the header falls back to the field label
body:
Filing gate ①: a declared-but-unenforced contract, reproduced in a browser (class b; also a class c trap for an AI author).
`reach:` the console list header, measured on objectstack-ai/hotcrm (`@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0) by the dev of objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2094 (report on that card, PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2098): an All Leads column authored with `label: { en: 'MAPEN Est', 'zh-CN': 'MAPZH 预计' }` built clean and reached `dist/objectstack.json`, and the header ignored it, showing the field label in both locales (预计金额 / Estimated Amount). A one-off experiment, never committed.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01P8mZuzuyZAHSrgQKmv6ASv`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: objectui triage, then the lane that owns `packages/plugin-grid`.
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed): "grid column label inline locale map I18nLabel ignored resolveColumnLabel header" → 15 hits, "list view column label translation pickLocalized object grid" → 10 hits. The nearest are the closed label-map family on navigation and Studio (objectui#11299, objectui#11100, objectui#11148, objectui#11181, objectui#11128) and objectui#5301 (dashboard widget panel); none is the grid column header.
Seam: `spec:ListColumnSchema.label (I18nLabelSchema)` → `renderer:plugin-grid ObjectGrid resolveColumnLabel`

## The contract

- objectstack `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1149` (`origin/main` `b5b1bf72`): a list column's `label` is `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`, "Display label override".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/i18n.zod.ts:242` documents the inline `{ en, 'zh-CN', … }` form as resolved by the renderer (`pickLocalized`), "so the map is a delivered capability". The installed 18.0.0-next.0 `dist/ui/index.d.ts` carries the same sentence (the dev's reading).

## The producer (objectui `origin/main` `065a1cf`)

`packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:514`:

```ts
function resolveColumnLabel(label: string | I18nLabel | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (label == null) return undefined;
  return typeof label === 'string' ? label : undefined;
}
```

Its callers at ~L3648 read the authored column label and then the field label through it, so a map is treated as absent and the header silently becomes the field label.

## Why it matters

- The plain-string form has no translation slot (the translation schema's `_views.VIEW` takes `label`, `description`, `emptyState` and `bulkActions` only), so the map is the ONLY spec-declared way to give a column a localized wording that differs from its field's. Today that way type-checks, builds and then does nothing.
- An AI author following the spec's own documentation writes the map and gets no signal at all.

## Fix direction (for the implementer to measure, ⛔ not a ruling)

- Resolve a map column label through the same locale pick the rest of the console uses for `I18nLabel` (`pickLocalized`), as the label-map family fixes did for navigation and Studio.
- Or, if a per-column wording is not wanted, the contract is narrowed at the spec instead; ⛔ never left declared and dropped.

## Acceptance

A list column whose `label` is an inline locale map renders the viewer's locale entry (with the spec's floor when absent), and a plain-string label renders unchanged.
